name: Inbox Zero
tagline: Open-source Superhuman alternative
description: Inbox Zero Mail is an open-source email client for Gmail and Outlook. Fast, keyboard-first, and free to use, on web, Mac, Windows and iPhone, with all your accounts in one inbox. Add AI for $20/mo: every email is sorted, and replies are drafted in your voice before you open them. Comment privately with your team, get Slack alerts, and give the AI context from your tools.

name: MyLens
tagline: 1-1 Live Presentations at Scale with AI.
description: MyLens is AI for live 1-1 presentations at scale. You add your raw sources, say what matters, and invite your audience. MyLens AI gives every person a live, private presentation, answers their questions using your sources, and create new slides and layers in real time during the presentation. Then the AI tells you how each session went, so you can see who’s doing well, who’s stuck, and what to do next.

name: shim-cli
tagline: See what your coding agent sends. Mask what you can.
description: An open-source hook and local proxy for Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI and VS Code. In Claude Code it masks secrets and personal data in tool results before the model reads them, and shim watch shows what a session sent and cost. No account, no telemetry.

name: Tower 18 for Mac
tagline: The most powerful Git client with a better CLI experience
description: Tower 18 for Mac is here! This update is all about improving the Tower experience in the terminal: the Tower Command Line Tool can now take you straight to any view in Tower (History, Blame, the Working Copy, Branches Review, and more) with a single command.

name: MeetPaw
tagline: Instant meetings from your mac menu bar
description: MeetPaw is a lightweight macOS menu-bar app that puts your meetings one click away. Spin up an instant Google Meet, Zoom, or Microsoft Teams link the moment you need it. The link is created, copied to your clipboard, and ready to share before you've switched windows. No tabs, no digging, no friction.

name: XBOX Nano Controller
tagline: Pocket-sized wireless gamepad with all 18 inputs
description: Take play to more places with the XBOX Nano Controller. Fit more play in your everyday in a smaller form factor. Connect via Bluetooth & play across devices.

name: 3AM Super Intelligence
tagline: Production incidents: investigated, proven, fixed
description: Meet 3AM, the AI on-call engineer for systems you can’t rewrite. It finds the root cause, rehearses the fix, and resolves the incident with one tap in Slack, all from inside your network.

name: Tomo for ChatGPT
tagline: Ask anything. Then play it, Duolingo-style.
description: Ask ChatGPT for a Tomo course on black holes and a game drops into the chat. Quick questions, hearts on the line. Any topic, even the chat you’re in. Pick your teacher, from The Professor to The Pirate. Add Tomo from Plugins in ChatGPT. No sign-up to start.

name: Bee Frontier and Bee Eclipse
tagline: Amazon's personal AI memory, now on your wrist or phone
description: Bee Frontier and Bee Eclipse are Amazon's new personal AI devices that help you remember what matters. Frontier is a wearable for your wrist or clothing, while Eclipse attaches magnetically to your phone. Both capture conversations and turn them into useful summaries, reminders, and follow-ups without retaining audio recordings. With Alexa+ integration, your personal AI memory can help you recall important details and act on them later.

name: Openbroca
tagline: Lightweight AI dictation for Mac that sounds like you
description: Openbroca is a native Swift AI dictation app for Mac, with a ~6.5 MB download. Press a shortcut, speak naturally, and get clean text right where you're typing. It removes fillers and repetition while keeping your meaning and tone, with no prompt tweaking. Includes a personal dictionary that learns from corrections, Typeless dictionary import, and translation into 28 languages. All features are free to try.

name: Popcraft
tagline: Generate video, images & audio from any AI agent
description: Paste one URL into Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or Claude Code and your agent can plan, cost-preview and generate video, images, music and SFX with Seedance 2.5, Veo 3.1, Kling 3.0, Nano Banana Pro and 20+ more. OAuth sign-in, no API key. 100 free credits.

name: Vampire Crawlers™
tagline: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors
description: From the somehow triple-BAFTA‑winning creators of Vampire Survivors, Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors turns the snowballing thrill of Survivors into a hyper turn‑based, card‑driven BLOBBER with rogue-lite elements. Build busted decks, explore familiar dungeons from a new perspective, and unleash world‑ending combos. Either take your time and be tactical, or play turns as fast as you humanly can: The outcome is always accurate, we call it hyper for a reason!

name: Gravity Notes
tagline: One list of notes, for you and your AI agents
description: Gravity is a notes app built on Andrej Karpathy's append-and-review note. Everything goes into one list, newest at the top. Old notes sink, and a swipe brings one back. You pay once, and your notes stay on your devices. New since the last launch: live Markdown, checklists, full exports, and a gravity CLI on the Mac that lets Claude Code, Codex or your own scripts read and write your notes. For iPhone, iPad, Mac and Android.

name: PasteKit
tagline: Format JSON, YAML & SQL privately
description: Paste JSON, YAML, XML, SQL, CSV or code and get formatted, validated output instantly. 58 formats, 48 converters and JSON tools (diff, schema, repair, jq). Everything runs in your browser, enforced by a strict CSP, so nothing you paste leaves your machine.

name: SpeechFast
tagline: Local Whisper for Mac
description: Hold fn and talk. SpeechFast types clean text at your cursor, in any app. Everything runs on your Mac. The speech model is downloaded once; after that, no audio and no text ever leaves your machine. It works offline, on a plane, behind a locked-down corporate network. Dictate in Mail, Slack, Notion, your code editor, anywhere you can type Filler words and false starts cleaned up with Apple Intelligence Your own vocabulary for names and jargon History of your recent dictations, stored locally

name: Krea 3
tagline: Krea's AI image model: 2K edits in under 8 seconds
description: Krea 3 is a fast AI image editing model built for creators and production teams. Edit images in under 8 seconds at native 2K resolution for just $0.06 per image. Change backgrounds, objects, materials, or lighting while preserving the details you want to keep. Use up to 6 reference images to maintain consistent products, characters, and styles across an entire campaign. Less waiting, fewer unwanted changes, and more room to experiment.

name: Latch
tagline: The app blocker you unlock by walking to your key
description: Latch locks distracting apps until you scan your key, and the key lives where you have to walk: an NFC sticker on the fridge, a printed QR code, or a number of steps. No account, no ads, no analytics. iPhone and Android; Pro is $9.99 once.

name: Zalcro
tagline: The pre-build planning tool for vibe coders and AI builders
description: Zalcro is the pre-build planning tool for AI app builders. Jumping straight into prompting usually leads to a doom loop where the AI loses context and breaks your app. Zalcro solves this by mapping out your architecture before you begin. It generates a build-ready plan so your AI knows exactly what to do. Whether you use Lovable, Replit, Cursor, or Claude Code, Zalcro gives you step-by-step prompts you paste directly or connect via MCP. Build better. Plan before you prompt,

name: Syllaby Mobile App
tagline: Save Up to 70% Of Your Content-Creation Time on the Go
description: Syllaby is your all-in-one AI studio for viral video creation. Instantly turn ideas into faceless or cinematic content with trending topics, ready-to-film scripts, and studio-quality visuals. From planning to publishing, Syllaby streamlines every step—so your content stays consistent, professional, and unmistakably yours.

name: Startories
tagline: The AI engine that finds your next B2B customers
description: Startories is an AI engine that catches B2B buyers while they're actively looking for solutions. It monitors Reddit, X, Product Hunt, directories and search for fresh buying signals, qualifies each company against your ICP, finds the decision-maker, verifies their email and starts personalized outreach. Instead of waiting for inbound leads to reach your website, Startories finds the demand already happening across the web.
